target_customer: mRNA researchers and therapeutic developers buying custom or off-the-shelf high purity RNA
problem: Therapeutic mRNA suffers from impurities such as double stranded RNA and endotoxin from plasmid based manufacturing, which hurt quality, yield and tolerability.
business_model: custom RNA synthesis service and off-the-shelf RNA product sales, plus grant funded R&D

founders.name: Hari Bhaskaran
education: PhD, UT Austin, RNA folding in the lab of Rick Russell
founders.background_notes: YC page: about 20 years working on catalytic RNAs with roles in academia and industry; employers not named.

technical_complexity.rationale: Ribozyme based 3 prime end trimming and a capture and cleavage purification method to remove dsRNA, requiring deep RNA biochemistry.

defensibility.rationale: Proprietary SPECC purification technology and a patent-holding founder, but no evidence of issued patents in sources opened.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found; sources show no news.

market_need_then: mRNA therapeutics surged after COVID vaccines and impurity control mattered for tolerability; the company site cites dsRNA and endotoxin problems as the target.

identity.visual_style: Science-focused, shows YC and NSF/NIH logos
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and mission driven; RNA revolution

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand and confusable with similarly named biotech companies.

outcome_analysis: Cisterna is a single founder deep tech company founded in 2022 and still active per YC with a team of two. The company shows YC, NSF, NIGMS and NCATS logos, suggesting grant funding, but no verified rounds, customers or news exist in the sources found, so the outcome is unresolved.
notes: Aggregators report a roughly 500K YC pre-seed in 2022 and a 0.27M NSF grant on 2024-08-15 (CB Insights); only one aggregator source for the grant and generic YC standard terms for pre-seed, so neither is recorded as a round. Competitor search found only an aggregator naming Moderna and BioNTech with no date; TriLink and Aldevron not confirmed, so list left empty. Location differs between sources (San Diego, Carlsbad). Completeness pass: the 500K pre-seed (2022-08) rests on VCBacked and other aggregators and matches YC standard terms; the 270K NSF grant (2024-08-15) rests on CB Insights alone. ConductScience lists NIH awards of about 350K and 350K to the founder as PI, not recorded because they are individual awards of unclear company link.
